title: WAPDA & Pakistan Power Sector
summary: Factual questions on WAPDA, dams and rivers, hydropower capacities, sector institutions, grid voltages. Learn the table of projects by heart.
definitions: Water and Power Development Authority, created by the WAPDA Act 1958; HQ WAPDA House, Lahore. Now focused on water and hydropower.
National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (Act of 1997): licences, tariffs, performance standards.
National Transmission & Despatch Company: 500 kV and 220 kV grid.
Distribution companies: LESCO, GEPCO, FESCO, IESCO, MEPCO, PESCO, HESCO, SEPCO, QESCO, TESCO; K-Electric serves Karachi.
Private Power and Infrastructure Board: facilitates IPPs.
Indus River System Authority (1992): implements the 1991 Water Apportionment Accord.
formulas: 500 kV, 220 kV (transmission) → 132, 66 kV (sub-transmission) → 11 kV (primary distribution) → 400/230 V
facts: Tarbela — Indus (KP), completed 1976; largest hydropower station; 4,888 MW after T4 (1,410 MW), 6,418 MW with T5 (1,530 MW).
Mangla — Jhelum (Mirpur, AJK), completed 1967; ~1,000 MW, being upgraded to ~1,310 MW.
Ghazi Barotha — Indus, run-of-river, 1,450 MW (5 × 290 MW), ~52 km power channel.
Diamer-Bhasha — Indus, ~4,500 MW, RCC dam ~272 m high.
Mohmand — Swat River, 800 MW, concrete-faced rockfill dam.
Indus Waters Treaty 1960 (World Bank): Indus, Jhelum, Chenab to Pakistan; Ravi, Beas, Sutlej to India.
Matiari–Lahore ±660 kV, 4,000 MW HVDC (2021) — Pakistan's first HVDC line.
Nuclear: Chashma C-1…C-4, K-2/K-3 (PAEC). Coal: Thar (Sindh), Sahiwal, Port Qasim, Hub. Wind: Jhimpir–Gharo. Solar: Quaid-e-Azam Solar Park, Bahawalpur.
Rawal Dam — Kurang; Simly — Soan; Khanpur — Haro; Mirani — Dasht; Hub — Hub River; Satpara — Skardu; Gomal Zam — South Waziristan.
WAPDA works under the Ministry of Water Resources; DISCOs/NTDC under the Power Division.
traps: Mangla is on the Jhelum, not the Indus.
Warsak is on the Kabul River; Mohmand Dam is on the Swat River.
Ghazi Barotha is run-of-river, not a storage dam.
T4 = 1,410 MW and T5 = 1,530 MW — don't swap them.
